x: Little need be said of the actual race, as Duffett, always up with the leaders, came away when he liked, to win by 20 seconds. The team race was always ours, and scoring 12 aside, our team finished in the first 20 places scoring 127 points against 282 by the Valley and 340 by Ashcombe

Duffett, L.L.King, F.R.Webb (Ashcombe A.C.) and myself. My earliest programme is dated August 26th 1926, this is for a Club Handicap Meeting, four events, 89 entries, only three entries from the 1938 list - A.E.Duffett, L.L.King, and myself.
